root_cause: Dashboard V2 called chart.priceScale('position') before any series owned the custom position price scale, which throws in lightweight-charts and blanked the K-line page.

data_boundary.interpretation: Actor NAV/replay remains clipped to the qlib safe replay end. Latest actor decisions are shown through stateless latest_signal rows rather than synthetic NAV extension.

changes: Configure the custom position price scale from the first position series instead of chart.priceScale('position').
Tighten chart tests so they fail on premature custom price scale access.
Remove the duplicate latest-signal strip when the latest decision matrix is present.
Rank model difference cards by latest signal position delta before historical mismatch counts.
Use a compact first-viewport grid for model difference cards and prioritize Signal delta, position delta, and NAV delta.
Reduce the main K-line height to leave the position, position-delta, delta-NAV, and rebased-NAV panes visible in the first viewport.
verification: PYTHONPATH=. qlib_venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_v2_data.py tests/test_dashboard_v2_checker.py tests/test_dashboard_v2_layout.py -q
